openExistingHint: Show this verified Codex thread without sending a message
openNewHint: Open a new Codex conversation in this project
nativeHint: Prepare a separate Agent chat; keep this terminal running
unavailable: The selected engine is unavailable. Choose an installed engine.
handoffHint: Open a task draft in Codex, then click Send there. Text you select in the chat before handing off is prefilled as a quote; only this text is handed off — the rest of the chat history and attachments are not included.
taskPlaceholder: Describe the goal, file scope and acceptance criteria. You can reference a local plan file.
taskTooLong: The task text is too long. Save a plan file and reference its path here.
awaitingSend: Requested the draft to open. Click Send in Codex to start execution.
quoteTruncated: The quoted text was too long and has been truncated. Save the full content to a plan file and reference its path here.
